subject: Data Engineering
title: The Star Schema
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Star Schema.

hook.text: Draw a fact table in the center with dimension tables around it. It looks like a star.

buildup.text: Star schemas have one fact table joined directly to denormalized dimension tables.

discovery.text: Queries are fast because each question needs at most one join per dimension — simple and predictable.

twist.text: Denormalized dimensions duplicate data. A country name might appear in a million rows.

climax.text: Star schemas trade storage for speed and simplicity — the right trade-off for analytics.

punchline.text: One fact, many dimensions, zero complexity. That's a star.

quiz.question: What is the main advantage of a star schema?
options: Simple, fast queries with minimal joins
